steps.name: Validate DE results table for GSEA ranking
caveats: sample_01 has ~4x-below-median library size; this was a raw-counts QC issue for the already-completed DESeq2 run and is not re-addressed here since only the results table is being used
steps.context: de_results.csv is the DESeq2 results table for the treated (psoriasis lesional) vs control skin contrast, 12000 rows x 8 columns, first columns gene, base_mean, log2_fold_change, log2_fold_change_se(implied). This validation gates the GSEA ranking step so the rank metric and gene keys are well-formed before enrichment.
steps.question: Does de_results.csv (12000 genes x 8 columns) contain the fields needed to build a pre-ranked gene list for the psoriasis lesional vs control contrast — gene symbol, log2_fold_change, and a p-value/stat column — with no duplicate or missing gene symbols that would break the hallmark gene-set join?
constraints: Do not re-run DESeq2 or touch raw counts.csv — DE is already computed and supplied
Do not filter genes by significance threshold here; ranking uses the full gene list
acceptance_criteria: Reports the exact column names/types of de_results.csv and confirms presence of gene identifier, log2_fold_change, and p-value (or Wald stat) columns
Reports count of missing/NA values in log2_fold_change and p-value columns and how they will be handled (drop vs impute)
Reports count of duplicate gene symbols and the deduplication rule applied (e.g., keep max |stat|)
Confirms gene identifiers are HGNC symbols compatible with the hallmark GMT (spot-checks a sample of known psoriasis genes e.g. KRT6A, S100A7, DEFB4A, IL17A/IL36G if present)

steps.name: Pre-ranked GSEA against MSigDB hallmark gene sets
caveats: If hallmark HGNC symbols overlap poorly with the de_results.csv gene identifiers (e.g., if de_results.csv uses Ensembl IDs instead of symbols despite the profile calling them 'gene symbol'), report the join-rate drop rather than silently proceeding on a small matched subset

Bulk tissue psoriasis lesional vs control differences (e.g., HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE, HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE, HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION, HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING) can reflect both immune infiltration and keratinocyte hyperproliferation — do not attribute a signal to one cell type without corroborating evidence
steps.context: Use the MSigDB human hallmark gene sets GMT (50 sets, HGNC gene symbols, /mnt/refs managed msigdb-hallmark-human collection) as the pathway reference. Input is the validated, deduplicated gene ranking produced in T1S1 from de_results.csv for the psoriasis lesional (treated) vs control (6 vs 6, unpaired) contrast. Standard fgsea pre-ranked GSEA (1000+ permutations or the exact/adaptive multilevel method) is appropriate given the moderate gene universe size.
steps.question: Using the validated DESeq2 treated (psoriasis lesional) vs control ranking (log2_fold_change signed by -log10(p-value) or Wald statistic) across all ~12,000 genes, which of the 50 MSigDB human hallmark pathways are significantly enriched (up or down) between psoriasis lesional and control skin?
constraints: Use fgsea (or an equivalent pre-ranked GSEA implementation) with BH FDR correction across all 50 hallmark sets tested — do not cherry-pick a subset of pathways
Report results for all sets whether or not they reach significance, not only the significant subset

State explicitly that this is bulk skin tissue (mixed keratinocyte/immune/stromal composition), so hallmark enrichment reflects tissue-level composition and pathway shifts jointly, not a single cell type's intrinsic biology
acceptance_criteria: Produces a full ranked-gene-list-to-hallmark-pathway GSEA result table with pathway name, NES, p-value, and BH-adjusted FDR for all 50 hallmark sets attempted
Reports which hallmark pathways pass FDR < 0.05 with their direction (NES sign) relative to psoriasis lesional vs control
Reports the leading-edge genes for each significant pathway
States the fraction of the 12,000-gene list that matched hallmark gene symbols (join rate) so silent gene-symbol mismatches are visible
Includes a plot (barplot or dot plot) of NES vs FDR for all tested hallmark pathways

plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control: hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: DESeq2 results for the treated (psoriasis lesional) vs control skin contrast (12,000 genes, 6 vs 6, unpaired) are already computed and supplied in de_results.csv. The research question asks specifically which hallmark pathways change between groups. Since DE is done, the correct next step is a single pre-ranked GSEA against the MSigDB human hallmark gene sets (50 sets, HGNC symbols) available in the reference store, run once on a ranking metric derived from the DESeq2 statistics (e.g., sign(log2FC) * -log10(pvalue) or the Wald stat if present), producing normalized enrichment scores and FDR per hallmark pathway. A concise validation/QC step first confirms the de_results.csv columns and gene-symbol format needed for the ranking and for joining to the hallmark GMT, and flags the known low-library sample_01 caveat as already absorbed into the supplied DESeq2 model (no re-normalization needed since DE is precomputed). No further transcriptomic reprocessing is warranted because raw counts were already used to generate the DE table; re-deriving DE would duplicate work not requested.
